description: The system shall allow users to access the portal through personal credential authentication.
The system shall validate user credentials and grant access to the portal only if they are valid.
The system shall display a list of applications to which the authenticated user has access.
The system shall only show the applications for which the user has authorized access.
The system shall allow users to access applications from the portal.
If the user has access to only one application, the system shall redirect them to its main page automatically.
The system shall restrict data visualization and actions (create, modify, delete) based on the user's assigned roles.
The system shall verify user roles and permissions upon accessing the Commercial Cloud data management application.
The system shall prevent users from accessing data belonging to other clients.
The system shall verify the client associated with the user and display only data belonging to that client.
The system shall convert any mention of the old name to the new name.
The system shall allow administrators to assign or revoke application access for users.
The new content must maintain visual coherence with the design of the old version of the application.
Design, colors, fonts, and organization must be consistent with the old version.
The system must be easy to use for any user.
80% of users shall not need to ask for help from third parties to use the application.
The application must be available in multiple languages.
Translations must be complete and correct in all supported languages.
The user must be able to perform new operations without special training.
The learning time for new functionalities should not exceed 5 minutes.
Query operations must have a load time of less than 1 second.
Response time must not exceed 1 second in 95% of queries.
The web application must guarantee continuous and stable operation, ensuring availability at all times.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during peak usage times.
The web application must support a large number of concurrent users without degrading performance.
System availability must be at least 99.9%, even during peak usage times.
The system must allow the creation, query, modification, and deletion of data for authorized users.
The system must have a secure authentication and permission verification mechanism to ensure users only access authorized information.
The application must manage a strict separation of data for each client.
No user shall be able to access data belonging to other clients.
Primary keys must be defined for: User, Language, ClusterType, Application, Authority, Role, Brand, and Cluster.
Dates must be valid and cannot be in the future.
Elements of the same type cannot share the same code.
